challenge.details.body: Lokhu kuhlola okufushane kusiza ukugcina iwebhusayithi itholakala kuwo wonke umuntu. Isiphequluli sakho senza umsebenzi omncane wokubala ukuze siqinisekise lokhu kuvakasha.
challenge.details.randomx: Ukuhlola okudinga amandla e-CPU noma imemori eyengeziwe, njenge-RandomX, kucela imvume yakho ngaphambi kokuqala. Ungashiya leli khasi uma ungafuni ukuqhubeka.
challenge.hashwx_unsupported: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukusebenzisa i-HashWX. Kudingeka ukwesekwa kwe-WebAssembly nama-Web Workers.
challenge.javascript_required: Sicela uvule i-JavaScript esipheqululini sakho, bese uvuselela leli khasi.
challenge.randomx_unsupported: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukusebenzisa i-RandomX. Kudingeka isiphequluli esisekela i-WebAssembly, i-BigInt nama-Web Workers.
challenge.state.consent.description: Lokhu kuhlola kusebenzisa amandla amaningi e-CPU nememori yedivayisi yakho. Kuzoqala kuphela uma ukhetha ukuqhubeka.
challenge.state.consent.title: Kusele isinyathelo esisodwa
challenge.state.expired.description: Lokhu kuhlola kuthathe isikhathi eside kunesilindelekile. Ukuphinda ukuhlola kungasiza.
challenge.state.expired.title: Ake sizame futhi
challenge.state.failed.description: Asikwazanga ukuqedela ukuhlola kulokhu. Kungase kuphumelele uma uzama futhi.
challenge.state.failed.title: Sicela uzame futhi
challenge.state.fast.description: Isiphequluli sakho senza ukuhlola okusheshayo. Lokhu kuvamise ukuqedwa ngokuzenzakalela.
challenge.state.fast.title: Linda isikhashana
challenge.state.hashwx.description: Isiphequluli sakho senza ukuhlola okusheshayo. Siyabonga ngokubekezela kwakho.

challenge.state.initializing.title: Siyalungiselela
challenge.state.limited.description: Sithole izicelo eziningi. Ukulinda isikhashana kungasiza.
challenge.state.limited.title: Sicela uzame futhi kamuva
challenge.state.network.description: Asikwazanga ukuxhumana nesevisi yokuqinisekisa. Sicela uhlole ukuxhumeka kwakho ku-inthanethi.
challenge.state.network.title: Ukuxhumeka kuphazamisekile
challenge.state.pool.description: Silinde isevisi yokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqinisekise umphumela.
challenge.state.pool.title: Sekusele kancane
challenge.state.preparing.title: Linda isikhashana
challenge.state.randomx.description: Isiphequluli sakho senza ukuhlola. Ungayigcina le thebhu ivuliwe.

challenge.state.success.title: Konke sekulungile!
challenge.state.unavailable.description: Isevisi yokuqinisekisa ayitholakali okwamanje. Sicela uzame futhi ngemva kwesikhashana.
challenge.state.unavailable.title: Kunokubambezeleka okuncane
